property_summary: For any caller and any msg.value, the reference contract requires lockInGuess to accept only calls that pay exactly 1 ether (calls with other msg.value revert), but the mutant allows any msg.value and thus can succeed when msg.value != 1 ether — so the universal rule: lockInGuess succeeds iff msg.value == 1 ether; the buggy version violates this by allowing other values to succeed.
change_summary: Remove the require(msg.value == 1 ether) check so callers can call lockInGuess with any value, changing whether state is updated after the call when msg.value differs.
